integrity: Proof-based increasing-window theorem with a finite independent checker; no claim that finite tests prove asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: The Gaussian statement uses exact finite-window centering; no rate, short-interval version, or local limit theorem is proved. Earlier exact finite-frequency work is a strong precursor, and exhaustive originality certification remains outstanding.
title: A Gaussian logarithmic law for consecutive-integer LCM quotients
